notes: Official LG US spec sheet (labeled '55VSH7J-H' on the PDF itself, which is the same product/SKU as '55VH7J-H' used on LG's product URLs — LG uses both forms interchangeably for this display; connectivity, dimensions, and electrical specs are identical). Connectivity 1-12 taken directly from LG's official rear-panel connectivity diagram and spec table. Not rack-mountable (wall/video-wall mounted display, VESA 600x400). No built-in speaker. RJ45 LAN speed not explicitly stated (only "RJ45(LAN): Yes"); eth-1g assumed as standard for this display class but not confirmed in spec. HDMI version not explicitly numbered; HDCP 2.2 support implies HDMI 2.0-class input, so hdmi-2.0 is inferred, not directly confirmed (panel is FHD only). DP version not stated numerically; dp-1.2 inferred, not confirmed. No dedicated AC-in connector is shown among the 12 numbered diagram ports — power entry is described only as "Power Supply: 100-240 Vac, 50/60Hz, Built-In Power" with a "Power Cord" listed as an included accessory, so the exact physical inlet type (captive cord vs. IEC C13/14) could not be visually confirmed; chosen "iec" as closest standard connector with low certainty on that one port. RS-232C IN/OUT are D-sub 9-pin connectors, mapped to "rs232" per allowed connector list.
